per_reviewer_assessments.prflow:silent-failure-hunter: No Critical/High/Medium findings. Traced both hypothesized failure modes to workpad.py behavior and both are neutralized: (1) zero-yield vs never-written is handled explicitly by the mandated all-zero-tally record on the clean path; (2) failed note write swallowed while tick succeeds is structurally impossible — --tick-progress and --note are both append args consumed by one cmd_update that rewrites the comment body in a single gh api edit, so either both land or the whole update fails loudly (an unticked gate is a visible blocking signal). Coupling the note to the visible tick makes the telemetry strictly safer. No inert guard; this is advisory telemetry prose, fails toward undercount not data loss. Fixed 3-integer format adds no injection surface.
